name: Multi-account SourceArn all disagreeing with SourceAccount (IAM-1204 regression)
note: IAM-1204 regression: an S3 bucket policy grants cloudtrail.amazonaws.com s3:PutObject constrained by StringEquals aws:SourceAccount 111122223333 AND ArnLike aws:SourceArn with a TWO-value list pinning accounts 444455556666 and 777788889999. Neither SourceArn account matches the SourceAccount, so the binding is internally inconsistent exactly like the single-account mismatch (suite-2 test 53). commonSourceAccount() collapses a multi-account value list to null, which previously skipped the mismatch guard and mis-credited this as a clean source-bound negative control at info severity. It must classify as state=mismatched at medium, name every disagreeing account, and NOT be praised as source-bound nor become a public-write finding.
